assumptions.state: No assumed initial match; compare all outputs after an observed reset step
assumptions.reset: Both models see active-low reset in step 1, then unconstrained reset
assumptions.clock: One common abstract clock step with async2sync reset semantics
assumptions.entropy: No entropy input on this partition
assumptions.logic: Defined binary inputs, no four-state X/Z or physical reset timing proof
